scope: Local BORTUS-only checkpoint coordinator qualification; no live capture or restore

initial_failure_retained.case: A lost stop reply left the known original writer terminating during conditional resume
initial_failure_retained.correction: Wait boundedly for that exact original UID to disappear before restoring the writer; foreign UIDs still refuse restart

coverage: Cold-only snapshot creation, full NAS backup and actual resumed writer ownership
Original false and true reconciliation flags and scoped mutations only
Original claim/PV/Longhorn/writer identity refusal before mutation
UID/resourceVersion/control-field JSON Patch fencing and strict scalar types
Lost mutation outcomes before and after application with no blind replay
Ambiguous snapshot retains holder, restores writer and never starts a backup
Foreign consumers block both cold capture and unsafe restart
API holder defaults allowed but credential, writable, root and helper drift refused
Recreated controller and untouched reconciliation flag drift refuse resume
Exact tagless digest grammar with schemes/tags/incomplete references refused
Foreign or credential-bearing backup URL never persisted and prevents cleanup
Patch and UID/resourceVersion delete preconditions use stdin instead of argv
Existing run or process lock never overwrites retained journals
